description: Knowledge base mapping AWS misconfigurations to remediation recommendations. Each entry has a stable 'id' meant to be used as the integration key by the AWS Scanner module (Member 1) and the Risk Scoring Engine (Member 2). 'aliases' allow matching against free-text misconfiguration strings if a scanner does not yet emit the standard id.

mappings.recommendation: Apply the Principle of Least Privilege. Replace AdministratorAccess with a custom policy containing only required permissions.
remediation_steps: Identify the actual permissions the user/role needs from CloudTrail activity.
Create a custom-scoped IAM policy covering only those permissions.
Detach AdministratorAccess and attach the custom policy.
Re-test the workflow to confirm nothing breaks.

mappings.recommendation: Avoid daily use of the root account. Create IAM users with administrative privileges and enable MFA on the root account.
remediation_steps: Create a named IAM admin user/role for daily operations.
Enable hardware or virtual MFA on the root account.
Store root credentials securely and use only for account-level tasks.
Set up a CloudWatch alarm for root login events.

mappings.recommendation: Enable Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for all privileged users.
remediation_steps: Identify all IAM users without MFA enabled.
Enroll each user in virtual or hardware MFA.
Enforce MFA via IAM policy conditions for sensitive actions.

mappings.recommendation: Delete or deactivate unused access keys older than 90 days.
remediation_steps: Run IAM credential report to find last-used dates.
Deactivate keys unused for 90+ days.
Delete keys after confirming no dependent workloads.

mappings.recommendation: Configure a strong password policy with minimum length, complexity, and expiration.
remediation_steps: Set minimum password length to 14+ characters.
Require uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol.
Set password expiration and prevent reuse of last 5 passwords.

mappings.recommendation: Enable Block Public Access and remove unnecessary public bucket policies.
remediation_steps: Enable S3 Block Public Access at the bucket and account level.
Review and remove overly permissive bucket policies and ACLs.
Grant access only to specific authorized IAM roles.
Enable default encryption on the bucket (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS).
For sensitive data, prefer SSE-KMS with a customer-managed key.
Enforce encryption via bucket policy (deny unencrypted PutObject).

mappings.recommendation: Enable versioning to protect against accidental deletion and ransomware.
remediation_steps: Enable versioning on the bucket.
Configure lifecycle rules to manage old versions and storage cost.
Consider enabling MFA Delete for critical buckets.

mappings.recommendation: Enable S3 Access Logging or CloudTrail logging.
remediation_steps: Enable S3 server access logging to a dedicated logging bucket.
Alternatively/additionally enable CloudTrail data events for the bucket.
Set retention and monitoring on the log bucket.

aliases: Security group allows SSH from anywhere
mappings.recommendation: Restrict SSH access to trusted IP addresses or use a Bastion Host.
remediation_steps: Identify the security group rule allowing 0.0.0.0/0 on port 22.
Restrict the source to known/trusted IP ranges or a VPN CIDR.
Consider routing SSH access through a Bastion Host or Session Manager instead.

aliases: Security group allows RDP from anywhere
mappings.recommendation: Restrict RDP access to authorized IP ranges only.
remediation_steps: Identify the security group rule allowing 0.0.0.0/0 on port 3389.
Restrict the source to authorized corporate/VPN IP ranges.
Consider using AWS Systems Manager Session Manager instead of RDP.
Enable detailed CloudWatch monitoring on the instance.
Set up alarms for CPU, memory (via agent), disk, and network anomalies.
Forward relevant logs to CloudWatch Logs.

mappings.recommendation: Enable EBS encryption using AWS KMS keys.
remediation_steps: Enable EBS encryption by default at the account/region level.
Snapshot existing unencrypted volumes and create encrypted copies.
Replace unencrypted volumes with the encrypted copies.

mappings.recommendation: Upgrade to Instance Metadata Service Version 2 (IMDSv2).
remediation_steps: Set the instance metadata options to require IMDSv2 (HttpTokens=required).
Update any application code/SDKs that assume IMDSv1 behavior.
Apply the setting account-wide for new instances via launch templates.
